title: A root's placeholder names reach no production path: redact and the tracked-file leak scan never pass a root
goal: redact.py takes --root DIR and applies that root's placeholders in its rules and in --scan; check.py's log-row scan passes the log's root to leak_hits, so a root's listed placeholder names pass in that root's log rows only while every leak shape stays the same for every root; kbpublic.file_hits takes a file's root and tree_hits, leak_verdicts and public_values read it from the nearest enclosing _root.md of the tree they scan, so a name that root lists passes in that root's files only while a different user and a GUID are still flagged there; the verdict cache of range_leaks is keyed on the placeholders of the roots it reads, so changing a root's placeholders gives a fresh verdict; test_leaks' tracked-file scan passes each file's root to file_hits

import kbcommon, check
home = 'C:' + chr(92) + 'Users' + chr(92) + 'anna.nowak' + chr(92) + 'x'
def log_errors(placeholders):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    open(d + '/_root.md', 'w').write('---\nroot: plx\nid_prefix: PX\nvisibility: internal\n' + ('placeholders: anna.nowak\n' if placeholders else '') + 'description: fixture\n---\n\n# plx\n')
    open(d + '/_logs.csv', 'w', newline='').write(','.join(check.LOG_COLS) + '\nL-aaaaaaaa,"seen 3 times at ' + home + '",20260101T000000Z-0123abcd,2026-01-01,2026-01-02,domain:x,proposed,,\n')
    root = kbcommon.load_root(d)
    del check.errors[:]
    check.check_logs(root, 'plx', {})
    out = list(check.errors)
    shutil.rmtree(d)
    return out
own, plain = log_errors(True), log_errors(False)
print(own); print(plain)
hit = lambda errs: [e for e in errs if 'leak-scan hit (home)' in e]
assert hit(plain), ('the same log row in a root with no placeholders is not flagged', plain)
assert not hit(own), ('a root lists the user as a placeholder and its log row is still flagged', own)
